{"content":"import io
import socket
import unittest
from unittest.mock import MagicMock

from paasio import MeteredFile, MeteredSocket


class MeteredFileTests(unittest.TestCase):
    def test_reads_and_writes_count_independently(self):
        raw = io.BytesIO(b"abcdef")
        with MeteredFile(raw) as stream:
            self.assertEqual((stream.read_bytes, stream.read_ops), (0, 0))
            self.assertEqual((stream.write_bytes, stream.write_ops), (0, 0))
            self.assertEqual(stream.read(2), b"ab")
            self.assertEqual(stream.read(), b"cdef")
            self.assertEqual(stream.read(), b"")
            self.assertEqual(stream.read(0), b"")
            self.assertEqual((stream.read_bytes, stream.read_ops), (6, 4))
            stream.seek(0)
            self.assertEqual(stream.write(b"xyz"), 3)
            self.assertEqual(stream.write(b""), 0)
            self.assertEqual((stream.write_bytes, stream.write_ops), (3, 2))
            stream.flush()
            self.assertEqual(raw.getvalue(), b"xyzdef")
        self.assertTrue(raw.closed)
        self.assertEqual(stream.read_bytes, 6)

    def test_iteration_counts_each_returned_line_once(self):
        with MeteredFile(io.BytesIO(b"one\ntwo\nthree")) as stream:
            self.assertIs(iter(stream), stream)
            self.assertEqual(list(stream), [b"one\n", b"two\n", b"three"])
            self.assertEqual((stream.read_bytes, stream.read_ops), (13, 3))
            with self.assertRaises(StopIteration):
                next(stream)
            self.assertEqual(stream.read_ops, 3)

    def test_empty_iteration(self):
        with MeteredFile(io.BytesIO()) as stream:
            self.assertEqual(list(stream), [])
            self.assertEqual((stream.read_bytes, stream.read_ops), (0, 0))

    def test_context_closes_on_error_and_propagates(self):
        stream = MeteredFile(io.BytesIO())
        with self.assertRaisesRegex(RuntimeError, "failure"):
            with stream as entered:
                self.assertIs(entered, stream)
                raise RuntimeError("failure")
        self.assertTrue(stream.closed)

    def test_failed_operations_do_not_change_counters(self):
        stream = MeteredFile(io.BytesIO())
        stream.close()
        with self.assertRaises(ValueError):
            stream.read()
        with self.assertRaises(ValueError):
            stream.write(b"abc")
        self.assertEqual((stream.read_bytes, stream.read_ops), (0, 0))
        self.assertEqual((stream.write_bytes, stream.write_ops), (0, 0))


class MeteredSocketTests(unittest.TestCase):
    def test_partial_sends_and_flags(self):
        raw = MagicMock()
        raw.send.side_effect = [2, 0, 1]
        stream = MeteredSocket(raw)
        self.assertEqual((stream.send_bytes, stream.send_ops), (0, 0))
        self.assertEqual(stream.send(b"abcd", 4), 2)
        raw.send.assert_called_with(b"abcd", 4)
        self.assertEqual(stream.send(b""), 0)
        raw.send.assert_called_with(b"", 0)
        self.assertEqual(stream.send(b"z"), 1)
        self.assertEqual((stream.send_bytes, stream.send_ops), (3, 3))
        self.assertEqual((stream.recv_bytes, stream.recv_ops), (0, 0))

    def test_receives_and_eof(self):
        raw = MagicMock()
        raw.recv.side_effect = [b"abc", b"d", b""]
        stream = MeteredSocket(raw)
        self.assertEqual(stream.recv(10, 2), b"abc")
        raw.recv.assert_called_with(10, 2)
        self.assertEqual(stream.recv(10), b"d")
        raw.recv.assert_called_with(10, 0)
        self.assertEqual(stream.recv(10), b"")
        self.assertEqual((stream.recv_bytes, stream.recv_ops), (4, 3))

    def test_failures_do_not_change_counters(self):
        raw = MagicMock()
        raw.recv.side_effect = OSError("read failed")
        raw.send.side_effect = OSError("write failed")
        stream = MeteredSocket(raw)
        with self.assertRaises(OSError):
            stream.recv(10)
        with self.assertRaises(OSError):
            stream.send(b"abc")
        self.assertEqual((stream.recv_bytes, stream.recv_ops), (0, 0))
        self.assertEqual((stream.send_bytes, stream.send_ops), (0, 0))

    def test_real_socket_io_and_context_cleanup(self):
        left, right = socket.socketpair()
        with right:
            right.settimeout(1)
            left.settimeout(1)
            stream = MeteredSocket(left)
            with stream as entered:
                self.assertIs(entered, stream)
                right.sendall(b"abc")
                self.assertEqual(stream.recv(3), b"abc")
                self.assertEqual(stream.send(b"z"), 1)
                self.assertEqual(right.recv(1), b"z")
            self.assertEqual(left.fileno(), -1)
            self.assertEqual((stream.recv_bytes, stream.recv_ops), (3, 1))
            self.assertEqual((stream.send_bytes, stream.send_ops), (1, 1))

    def test_context_closes_on_error_and_propagates(self):
        left, right = socket.socketpair()
        with right:
            with self.assertRaisesRegex(RuntimeError, "failure"):
                with MeteredSocket(left):
                    raise RuntimeError("failure")
            self.assertEqual(left.fileno(), -1)


if __name__ == "__main__":
    unittest.main()
